entities.summary: Abu al-Hakam Awana ibn al-Hakam ibn Awana ibn Wazr ibn Abd al-Harith al-Kalbi was an Arab historian based in Kufa and a major source for Umayyad history in the works of Hisham ibn al-Kalbi and al-Mada'ini.
